pages.text: The Carving Knife is a simple tool crafted from a Stick, an Iron Ingot and a Crystallized Bond. While it can be used as a Sword in combat - even supporting the same enchantments - it is ill-advised to do so. Instead, it is much more useful for carving off flesh from $(l:alteration_blocks/tissue_skin_hair)$(0)$(n)Tissue$() blocks, tearing scutes off of Turtles or harvesting the horns of a Goat.

Tissue blocks that have had Organic Matter applied will not decay after reducing the flesh on them. As for the scutes or horns, harvesting them in such a forceful way will hurt the animal. Additionally, it can be used to carve off one's own flesh if used while crouching...
